_note: The cast the PUBLIC build ships with. Original to the beta, deliberately not the characters from the book. Build with --cast mine to use data/character-forge and data/scene-composer instead.

name.full: Odile Marchetti of the Ninth Landing

characters.epithet: who kept the stairwell lights on for eleven years
mannerisms: checks a light is off twice
keeps other people's keys on her own ring
will not sit with her back to a door
characters.aspiration: to hand the building to somebody who will bother
characters.fear: that bothering was the whole of her
characters.gift: she notices what is missing before anyone notices it is gone
characters.wound: a tenancy she could not stop
characters.secret: she has a spare key to every flat and has used exactly one

threads.desc: who has not paid in a year and whom she has not reported

name.full: Teodor Bask from the wet side

characters.epithet: who sold the same umbrella four times
mannerisms: counts change he has already counted
talks faster when he is telling the truth
characters.voice: quick, warm, and about eight per cent inaccurate
characters.aspiration: one stall with his name painted on it properly
characters.fear: being small in a way that shows
characters.gift: he can price anything within a minute of seeing it
characters.wound: a debt paid off by someone he never thanked

threads.desc: two pitches down, who taught him everything and says so

name.full: Wren Achebe of the cold array

characters.epithet: who talks to the machines and is not embarrassed about it
mannerisms: repeats the last three words of a question before answering it
keeps one hand on a wall in a new room
characters.voice: low and unhurried, like somebody reading to a child who is nearly asleep
characters.aspiration: to be understood once, exactly, by anybody
characters.fear: that precision and warmth are a choice and she chose wrong
characters.gift: she can hear when a system is about to fail
characters.secret: she stopped believing in the work two winters ago and has not said

threads.desc: who leaves notes on her console and has never signed one

characters.epithet: who has never once been late
mannerisms: finishes other people's sentences and is usually right
will not say a name he has not earned
characters.voice: gravel with the grain still in it
characters.aspiration: to be the reason one young person stays in the trade
characters.gift: he can tell what broke by the sound it made
characters.secret: he cannot read the new schematics and has been guessing since spring

threads.desc: whose bench he still uses and whose name he does not say

cast.name: Odile Marchetti of the Ninth Landing
Teodor Bask from the wet side

beats.prose: The stairwell at pre-dawn, the rain still deciding. The building makes the noises a building makes when it thinks nobody is up.
beats.label: Establish

beats.prose: Odile is already on the landing with a bulb in her hand, which means she has been up for an hour and will not say so.
beats.label: Enter

beats.prose: Teodor takes the stairs two at a time and then slows, badly, so it looks like he was always walking.
beats.label: Enter

beats.prose: For a moment Odile thinks he is somebody else. The mistake corrects itself and leaves its shape behind.
beats.label: Recognize

beats.prose: Teodor offers to do it. Odile hands him the bulb, which is not the same as saying yes, and watches him get it wrong twice.
beats.label: Turn

beats.prose: The light comes on. Neither of them mentions that she could have done it in a minute, and both of them know that was not the point.
beats.label: Settle

cast.name: Wren Achebe of the cold array

beats.prose: The quarry floor at dusk. Everything here is loud in a way you stop hearing after a week, and Wren has not been here a week.
beats.label: Establish

beats.prose: Casimir says it is the third bearing. He has not looked at it. He is right.
beats.label: Turn

beats.prose: Wren asks how he knows. It is a real question, asked the way she asks everything, and it lands on him harder than a doubt would have.
beats.label: Pressure

beats.prose: He tells her about the sound. Somewhere in the telling it stops being about the bearing.
beats.label: Reveal

beats.prose: The shift horn goes. Neither of them moves for a second longer than they need to.
beats.label: Settle
